title: Xiaomi Human-Vehicle-Home Holographic Agent Architecture (L0-L5)
full_script: Welcome to Xiaomi Holographic Agent Architecture powered by PHANTOM GRID. L0 Base Foundation: E2E CRC-8, 4-bit Alive Counter, and 2.3ms Flash Tearing Rollback. L1 Distributed Grid: 3-Node CAN Topology with 100ms stepped ladder recovery. L2 Signal-to-Service: CAN to SOME/IP UDP serialization and In-Memory Digital Twin. L3 Edge Autonomous Healer: 3-tier dynamic derating at 75C and 85C with SQLite audit logs. L4 In-Vehicle Stdio MCP: Standard JSON-RPC tools with Human-in-the-Loop dual-signature. L5 Fleet Swarm: Nostr Kind 30078 encrypted mesh broadcast and Edge-Cloud hybrid routing. Extreme Adversary Resilience: AST Prompt Injection Disinfector and Byzantine Jabber Isolation. 100% Verified Production Ready: All 8 exam challenges achieved HONORS PASS.
